name: block-logos
title: Block Logos
description: Customer logo wall: brand tiles that sit desaturated and colorize on hover, as real links with styled wordmarks when no image assets exist.

name: block-stats
title: Block Stats
description: Stats band: numbers count up from zero on scroll-in with an always-present settled value for screen readers; formatting, prefixes and suffixes are props.

name: block-team
title: Block Team
description: Team cards: avatar (image or auto-generated initials badge), name, role and profile links; the whole card is hoverable and linkable.

name: block-gallery
title: Block Gallery
description: Work gallery grid with hover lift and an optional lightbox — a real dialog with Escape, arrow keys, focus trap and focus restore; generated CSS artwork by default.

name: block-timeline
title: Block Timeline
description: Company or product timeline: a rail that draws itself in on scroll, dots lighting up in sequence, alternating sides on wide screens.

name: block-newsletter
title: Block Newsletter
description: Email signup with working client-side validation, announced inline errors and a confirmation panel; runs in an honestly-labeled demo mode until wired up.

name: block-contact
title: Block Contact
description: Contact section: a direct-channels list beside a configurable form skeleton — labeled fields, native validation, and a confirmation state on submit.

name: block-banner
title: Block Banner
description: Announcement banner: a slim accent strip with an optional action, a labeled dismiss control, Escape handling and sticky-top positioning.

name: block-milestones
title: Block Milestones
description: Milestone progress: completed steps light up in sequence on scroll, the current step breathes, and upcoming steps stay dimmed — all driven by one index.

name: block-quote-wall
title: Block Quote Wall
description: Quote wall: many quotes in masonry columns, or one at a time in a rotator with keyboard controls, hover/focus pause and reduced-motion respect.
